name: heading
label: Title
description: A user provides a title for the Dashboard overview if the default title, Dashboards, is not what you want to show in your instance. The title appears at the top of the Dashboard overview component.

name: limit
label: Number of dashboard tiles
description: Number of dashboard tiles displayed in the Dashboard overview

name: displayAllDashboards
label: Display all dashboards
description: When toggled on, user sees all dashboards in the Dashboard overview; when toggled off, user sees the options Show all, Show certified, Show bookmarked, Show tab specific language.

name: showImagePreview
label: Show card images
description: Shows images on the dashboard cards. Image set in each dashboard's metadata.

name: filter
label: Default tab/filter
description: User provides the name of the default tab on the minified view and the default filter on the expanded view.

name: showAllTab
label: Show All
description: User sees the All tab in the minified view, in addition to the Bookmarked and Certified tabs

name: showCertified
label: Show Certified
description: User sees the Certified tab in the minified view

name: showBookmarked
label: Show bookmarked
description: User sees the Bookmarked tab in the minified view

name: hideCreateButton
label: Hide create button
description: In the minified view, hides the create new dashboard button

name: showPersonalizedLanguage
label: Show tab specific language
description: In the minified view, the user sees View all dashboards on the All tab, View all bookmarked dashboards on the Bookmarked tab and View all certified dashboards on the Certified tab

name: defaultExperienceId
label: Experience ID
description: Filters to dashboards in the provided experience ID
